tools.name: create_package
tools.description: Create a new R package skeleton at the specified path using usethis::create_package(). Sets up DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE, and the R/ directory.

path.description: Absolute path where the new package directory should be created (e.g. '/home/user/mypackage').

fields.description: Named list of extra DESCRIPTION fields, e.g. {Author: 'Jane Doe', Version: '0.1.0'}.

open.description: Whether to open the new package in RStudio (default false).

tools.name: use_r
tools.description: Add a new R source file under R/ in an existing package using usethis::use_r(). Creates 'R/<name>.R' with minimal boilerplate.

name.description: Name of the R script (without .R extension).

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: use_test
tools.description: Create a matching test file under tests/testthat/ for a given function or module using usethis::use_test(). Automatically sets up testthat if not already configured.

name.description: Name of the function or module to create a test file for.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: use_readme_md
tools.description: Add a README.md to the package root using usethis::use_readme_md().

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: use_vignette
tools.description: Create a new vignette stub (Rmd file) under vignettes/ using usethis::use_vignette().

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: use_mit_license
tools.description: Add an MIT LICENSE file and update DESCRIPTION License field using usethis::use_mit_license().

copyright_holder.description: Name to include in the copyright notice (defaults to package author).

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: use_gpl3_license
tools.description: Add a GPL-3 LICENSE file and update DESCRIPTION License field using usethis::use_gpl3_license().

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: use_package
tools.description: Add a package dependency to DESCRIPTION using usethis::use_package(). Supports Imports, Suggests, Depends, LinkingTo, and Enhances.

package.description: Name of the R package to add as a dependency.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: use_testthat
tools.description: Configure the testthat testing infrastructure for a package using usethis::use_testthat(). Creates tests/testthat/ and adds testthat to Suggests.

edition.description: testthat edition to use (e.g. 3). Defaults to latest stable edition.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: use_git
tools.description: Initialise a Git repository in the package and make an initial commit using usethis::use_git().

message.description: Message for the initial commit (default: 'Initial commit').

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: use_github
tools.description: Create a GitHub remote for the package and push using usethis::use_github(). Requires a GitHub PAT configured via GITHUB_PAT or gh_token().

organisation.description: GitHub organisation to create the repo under (optional, defaults to personal account).

private.description: Create as a private repository (default false).

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: use_data
tools.description: Export one or more R objects as package data files under data/ using usethis::use_data(). The objects must already be loaded in the R environment.

object_names.description: Character vector of R object names already loaded in the workspace to export as package data.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: use_pipe
tools.description: Add the magrittr pipe (%>%) to the package via usethis::use_pipe(). Creates utils-pipe.R and updates NAMESPACE.

export.description: Whether to export the pipe operator (default true).

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: load_all
tools.description: Simulate installing and attaching the package using devtools::load_all(). Makes all functions available in the current R session for interactive testing.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

reset.description: Whether to reset the namespace before loading (default false).

recompile.description: Whether to recompile C/C++/Fortran code (default false).

tools.name: document
tools.description: Generate roxygen2 documentation and update NAMESPACE using devtools::document(). Reads @-tags from R source and creates man/*.Rd files.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

roclets.description: Character vector of roclet names to use (e.g. ['rd', 'namespace']). Defaults to all.

tools.name: test
tools.description: Run the package's test suite (or a filtered subset) using devtools::test(). Reports test results in the chosen format.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

filter.description: Regex pattern to restrict which test files are run (e.g. 'my_func').

reporter.description: testthat reporter to use (e.g. 'progress', 'summary'). Defaults to 'progress'.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Run R CMD check on the package using devtools::check(). Identifies errors, warnings, and notes that would prevent CRAN submission.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

document.description: Whether to run devtools::document() before checking (default true).

cran.description: Whether to use CRAN-specific settings (default false).

error_on.description: Minimum check severity that causes an error: 'never', 'note', 'warning', or 'error' (default 'warning').

tools.name: install
tools.description: Install the package into the local R library using devtools::install().

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

dependencies.description: Whether to install package dependencies (default TRUE for Imports/Depends/Suggests).

tools.name: build
tools.description: Build a source (or binary) package tarball using devtools::build().

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

path.description: Destination directory for the built tarball/zip (defaults to the parent of the package directory).

binary.description: Whether to build a binary package instead of source (default false).

tools.name: build_readme
tools.description: Render README.Rmd to README.md and update GitHub preview using devtools::build_readme().

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: spell_check
tools.description: Spell-check the package documentation and vignettes using devtools::spell_check().

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

tools.name: renv_init
tools.description: Initialise an renv project-local library for the project using renv::init(). Creates renv/ and renv.lock, and updates .Rprofile.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the project root where renv should be initialised.

bare.description: If TRUE, initialise without installing any packages into the new library (default false).

restart.description: Whether to restart the R session after initialising (default false).

tools.name: renv_snapshot
tools.description: Record the current package dependencies into renv.lock using renv::snapshot().

project_path.description: Absolute path to the renv-managed project root.

tools.name: renv_restore
tools.description: Restore packages from renv.lock to recreate the recorded environment using renv::restore().

project_path.description: Absolute path to the renv-managed project root.

rebuild.description: Whether to rebuild packages from source (default false).

tools.name: renv_status
tools.description: Report whether the project library is synchronised with renv.lock using renv::status().

project_path.description: Absolute path to the renv-managed project root.

tools.name: renv_install
tools.description: Install packages into the renv project library using renv::install(). Supports CRAN packages, GitHub (user/repo), or version-pinned installs.

packages.description: Package names (and optional version specifiers) to install, e.g. ['ggplot2', 'dplyr@1.0.0'].

project_path.description: Absolute path to the renv-managed project root.

rebuild.description: Whether to rebuild packages from source (default false).

tools.name: renv_update
tools.description: Update packages in the renv project library using renv::update(). If no package names are given, all outdated packages are updated.

packages.description: Package names to update. If omitted, all packages are updated.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the renv-managed project root.

tools.name: renv_clean
tools.description: Remove unused packages or temporary files from the renv library using renv::clean().

project_path.description: Absolute path to the renv-managed project root.

actions.description: Specific cleaning actions to perform (default: all applicable actions).

tools.name: test_file
tools.description: Run a single testthat test file using testthat::test_file(). Useful for rapid iteration on a specific file.

file.description: Absolute path to the test file to run (e.g. '/path/to/tests/testthat/test-utils.R').

reporter.description: testthat reporter to use (e.g. 'progress', 'summary', 'tap'). Defaults to 'progress'.

stop_on_failure.description: Whether to stop immediately on the first test failure (default false).

project_path.description: Optional absolute path to the package root (used to set the working directory).

tools.name: test_dir
tools.description: Run all test files in a directory (optionally filtered) using testthat::test_dir(). Returns a summary of pass/fail/skip counts.

path.description: Absolute path to the directory containing test files.

filter.description: Regex pattern to restrict which test files are run (e.g. 'my_func').

reporter.description: testthat reporter to use (e.g. 'progress', 'summary', 'tap'). Defaults to 'progress'.

stop_on_failure.description: Whether to stop immediately on the first test failure (default false).
